title: How the snare drum is held and blown on while the bass drum keeps going
summary: Allen presses for the mechanics: he stands, holds the snare drum to his mouth with the left hand, blows on the snare-side skin, and keeps beating with a stick and the bass drum.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

One hand on the snare drum and the other one with the drum up to my mouth.
